sphere_commentary.overview:
The dataset reflects early‑stage therapeutic research with broadly positive outcomes and notable analytical variability.
• Aggregate means hover around 7.0 across series, indicating baseline efficacy.
• Standard deviations are modest in HEALING but larger in TRANSFORMING, matching design intent.
• YouTube engagement signals are sparse and retention data missing, limiting behavioral inference.
• Embedding drift is high for most protocols, suggesting evolving listener interpretations.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
HEALING, THRIVING, and TRANSFORMING each display patterns aligned with their design goals.
• HEALING shows the largest sample size and the lowest variance, especially in anxiety and overstimulation entries.
• THRIVING achieves peak scores in Focus & Clarity (Summit) and maintains moderate variance.
• TRANSFORMING exhibits the widest spread and lower means, consistent with its ascending‑arc approach to low‑affect states.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several signals deviate from expected patterns and merit focused investigation.
• X-MC-L3 (Cosmos) records a low mean (5.7) with high std (2.45), indicating possible design‑population mismatch.
• X-MD-L3 (Switchback) shows high std (2.38) despite a modest n (13), suggesting bimodal response.
• H-CR-L1 (Anchor) underperforms AutoGluon crisis prediction (observed 6.35 vs predicted 7.96).
• T-FC-L1 (Compass) receives rhythm‑busyness complaints, potentially limiting entrainment.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT similarity <0.70 for many protocols, flagging analytical instability.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted refinements can enhance efficacy signals and data robustness.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X-ME-L1 (Breeze) – adjust Adviser routing to capture cross‑zone potential.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] T-FC-L1 (Compass) – increase hold phase duration to reduce rhythm busyness.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-SL-L2 (Hammock) – investigate caregiver vs self‑listener split to clarify mixed outcomes.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] TRANSFORMING series – expand recruitment to raise n above 50 for more stable confidence.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-OS-L1 (Pebble) – develop L2 variant to scale successful overstimulation response.
• X-MD-L1 (Footpath) – pilot L2 variant to test predicted high efficacy (AutoGluon 7.88).
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding signals indicate substantial analytical drift and limited clustering.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT: 29 of 30 protocols show similarity <0.85, with X-MD-L3 at 0.507 (high drift).
• CROSS‑PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Insufficient embeddings for meaningful clustering.
• Confidence note: High drift reduces certainty in longitudinal semantic comparisons.
